Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO is a book build issue of ₹50.77 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 45.62 lakh shares aggregating to ₹41.05 crores and offer for sale of 10.80 lakh shares aggregating to ₹9.72 crores.

Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO bidding started from Aug 27, 2026 and ended on Aug 31, 2026. The allotment for Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO was finalized on Sep 1, 2026. The shares got listed on the BSE SME on Sep 3, 2026.

Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO is set final issue price at ₹90 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,88,000 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹4,32,000.

Corporate Capital Ventures Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is R.K.Stock Holding Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO RHP for detailed Information.

About Kwick Forensic Solutions Ltd.

Updated on Sep 4, 2026

Incorporated in March 2005, Kwick Forensic Solutions Limited (formerly Kwick Soft Solutions Private Limited) is engaged in providing forensic science, evidence management, cyber and digital forensics, DNA forensics and law-enforcement solutions across India. The Company initially focused on software development, including 3D rendering, animation and simulation, and subsequently expanded into forensic science and training technologies. Since FY2015, it has developed and supplied end-to-end forensic products, solutions, tools and technologies for crime scene investigation, fingerprint science, cyber/digital forensics, social-media analytics and evidence management.

The Company offers a diversified portfolio of forensic products and services, including fingerprint and physical evidence kits, evidence collection kits, Mobile Crime Scene Investigation Vehicles, digital forensic tools, DNA forensic solutions, handheld forensic devices and rental services for forensic equipment. It also provides product demonstrations, operating training, installation and post-delivery technical support. Its customers include police departments, central and state forensic laboratories, fingerprint bureaus, crime investigation departments, police training academies, universities and other government and private-sector institutions. The Company also sources products from international and domestic OEMs and has progressively increased domestic procurement to support supply continuity and cost efficiency.

The Company is supported by R&D and quality-management capabilities, including a branch facility used for R&D, product demonstrations and proof-of-concept forensic laboratory activities. Its quality systems are supported by ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, along with registrations with MSME, DSIR and NSIC.

As of July 31, 2026, the Company had 33 employees on payroll and 12 employees on contract, with personnel deployed across administration, finance, legal and compliance, operations, R&D, sales and marketing, tendering and management functions.

Strengths

  • End-to-end forensic science and evidence-management solutions.
  • Diversified portfolio covering physical, digital, cyber and DNA forensics.
  • Strategic relationships and tie-ups with global forensic technology providers.
  • Focus on niche forensic and law-enforcement market segments.
  • In-house R&D and development of forensic handheld devices and solutions.
  • Strong quality-management systems supported by multiple ISO certifications.
  • Growing domestic sourcing network supporting supply continuity and cost efficiency.

IPO FAQs

Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO is a SME IPO of 56,41,600 equity shares of the face value of ₹10 aggregating up to ₹51 Crores. The issue is priced at ₹90 per share. The minimum order quantity is 1600.

The IPO opens on Thu, Aug 27, 2026, and closes on Mon, Aug 31, 2026.

Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar for the IPO. The shares are proposed to be listed on BSE SME.

Zerodha customers can apply online in Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form.

Steps to apply in Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO through Zerodha

  1. Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console.
  2. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link.
  3. Go to the 'Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO' row and click the 'Bid' button.
  4. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price.
  5. Submit IPO application form.
  6. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM) to approve the mandate.

Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

The Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO opens on Thu, Aug 27, 2026 and closes on Mon, Aug 31, 2026.

Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO lot size is 1600, and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,88,000, with 2 lots being the minimum application size.

You can apply in Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha, Upstox, 5Paisa, Nuvama, HDFC Bank, and SBI Bank.

The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO will be done on Tuesday, September 1, 2026, and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Sep 2, 2026. Check the Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO allotment status.

The Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO listing date is on Thu, Sep 3, 2026.
